**Instructions for PowerPoint:** Place the image below on the right half of your slide. Copy and paste the text sections below into the left half of your slide.

### [Image for Right Side]
![Problem vs Solution Infographic](C:\Users\25beevdt047\.gemini\antigravity-ide\brain\fc062c57-190e-4ee8-816f-4efd1e49c6b8\problem_solution_infographic_1789388850457.jpg)

***

### [Text for Left Side]

**Core Problem & Proposed Solution:**
*   **Problem:** Silent failures (hidden heat/dryness) kill worms, and harvest guesswork yields unverified, poor-quality compost.
*   **Vermikendra:** A solar-powered, off-grid IoT ecosystem that predicts risks and provides verifiable batch data.

**Detailed Explanation of Prototype:**
*   A sensor node measures 5-point bed temperature, moisture, and CO2, sending data via LoRa to a local gateway hub.
*   An offline dashboard processes this data using edge-AI to give the operator clear status updates without needing the internet.

**How it Addresses the Problem:**
*   It issues early-warning alerts (e.g., "Shade the bin") *before* mass worm mortality occurs.
*   Replaces guesswork with an exact "Readiness" estimate and logs every kg of waste automatically.

**Innovation & Uniqueness:**
*   **Depth-Resolved Sensing:** 5-point probe catches hot layers single sensors miss.
*   **Respiration Readiness:** Uses CO2 trends to scientifically measure maturity.
*   **100% Off-Grid:** Operates entirely without SIM cards or cloud dependency."

## Detailed Slide Breakdown & Technical Depth

### 1. Bin Instrumentation & Physical Nodes (Left Column)
- **Isometric Cutaway CAD Diagram**: Directly embeds the engineered CAD rendering ([`academic_isometric_bin_1789388647042.jpg`](file:///C:/Users/25beevdt047/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain/fc062c57-190e-4ee8-816f-4efd1e49c6b8/academic_isometric_bin_1789388647042.jpg)) displaying sensor probe depths, lid pod, and bottom tare platform.
